snippet.title: Conjurers | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
The Neo Zodiac has arrived.
Wishlist Conjurers on Steam ➤
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878390/Conjurers/

Command mythical creatures, shape your deck, and outplay rival Conjurers in a tactical battle where cards, creatures, and terrain collide!

If you love games that mix:
✨ Deep deckbuilding and tactical positioning
🔮 Creature combos and hybrid evolution
♟️ Terrain-influenced turn-based strategy
🌌 A mythic Zodiac of beasts and spells

Then this is your kind of battlefield. Conjure your deck. Command your creatures. Conquer the stars.
